articles.title: Maternal Tdap Blunts Preschoolers' Pertussis Shot Response, but Booster Revives Them
articles.excerpt: (MedPage Today) -- Children whose mothers were vaccinated against tetanus, diphtheria, and pertussis (Tdap) during pregnancy saw significantly reduced immunity response to their own early childhood vaccination, although childhood vaccine boosters...
articles.summary: 孕期接种Tdap的母亲所生儿童，对自身早期百日咳疫苗的免疫应答显著降低，但儿童期加强针可恢复或增强其免疫应答。

articles.title: Menopause leaves a fingerprint that may predict dementia risk
articles.excerpt: As women go through menopause, they often sense that it's not just their bodies changing, but also their minds. They report hot flashes, anxiety, brain fog and trouble sleeping—all symptoms that can be traced back to the brain.
articles.summary: 文章讨论女性绝经期除身体变化外，还可能出现潮热、焦虑、脑雾和睡眠困难等与大脑相关的症状，并提出绝经可能留下可预测痴呆风险的“指纹”。
